Aleph Skill **v2.11.0** pins upstream-attested **D Research `v3.9.0`** (`249` locked runtime files) and ships comprehensive lifecycle hardening across Monte Carlo execution-trace binding, shock-aware sensitivity analysis, assumption-only sealed roleplay receipts, interactive multi-actor roleplay ergonomics, LLM schema repair, and report/contract validation.

## Highlights

- **Bundled Upstream-Attested D Research `v3.9.0` (`aleph-component://d-research`).** Upgrades the locked research component to official D Research `3.9.0` (`249` runtime files verified against the signed upstream tag and SLSA-attested release archives in `component-lock.json`), bringing contraction-aware and multi-sentence verbatim grounding (`research:grounding`), canonical publisher-domain lineage clustering (`research:lineage`), Unicode `NFC` Vietnamese term harvesting (`research:harvest`), intra-branch conflict reconciliation (`research:reconcile`), and structured JSON blocker diagnostics when headless Chromium is unavailable.
- **Resilient Monte Carlo Trace Binding & Total Unresolved Mass (`Formula 2.2.0`).** `scripts/aleph/execution_binding.py` (`select_monte_carlo_trace_run_id`, `generate_workspace_execution_trace`), `scripts/run_simulation.py`, and `scripts/replay_simulation.py` automatically bind the first valid converged `run_id` when sample `run:0` diverges or fails constraints, and emit a schema-valid unresolved trace (`invalid_mass: 1.0`, `steps: []`) when all Monte Carlo draws are invalid under permitted `max_invalid_fraction: 1.0`.
- **Shock-Aware Sensitivity Hash Parity (`scripts/run_sensitivity.py`).** Loads `simulation-config.json` and forwards `stochastic_shocks` identically to `compile_model.py`, ensuring `sensitivity-report.json` maintains bit-exact `model_hash` parity with `simulation-model.json` so shocked workspaces pass `validate_simulation_artifacts.py --mode final` with `artifact_paths.sensitivity_report` registered.
- **Initialized-Workspace Trace Protection (`scripts/aleph/auto_causal.py`).** `apply_model(..., into_initialized=True)` enforces strict pre-existing artifact guards (`REFUSED_EXISTING_SIMULATION_DATA`), refusing to overwrite workspaces that already contain `execution-trace.json`, `simulation-model.json`, `simulation-run.json`, `replay-report.json`, or non-template `propagation-trace.jsonl` records.
- **Sealed Assumption-Actor Receipts & Automatic HMAC Key Resolution (`scripts/aleph/packets.py`, `quality.py`, `finalize.py`).** Adds `verify_assumption_roleplay_receipt()` so scenarios combining evidence-backed actors with `actor_basis: "assumption"` or `"fictional"` actors (zero research rows + one sealed root roleplay row) achieve full `roleplay_tier: "A"` and `assurance_tier: "verified"`. `evaluate()` and `finalize_workspace()` also resolve `ALEPH_RECEIPT_KEY` and `D_RESEARCH_LEDGER_KEY` from environment variables automatically.
- **Interactive Multi-Actor Roleplay Ergonomics (`scripts/interactive_roleplay.py`).** `init --config` natively parses ISO-8601 `timestep` durations (`"P1M"`, `"P1D"`, `"P1W"`, `"P1Y"`), tolerates workspace-level config metadata, validates `_config_errors()` upfront, and normalizes `objectives`-synthesized `state_weights` consistently across `init` and `advance --spec`.
- **LLM Schema Repair & Negated-Disclaimers Precision (`scripts/repair_model_schema.py`, `validator.py`).** Automatically swaps reversed `[hi, lo]` node bounds (`REVERSED_BOUNDS_SWAPPED`), normalizes unprefixed `gate.conditions[].node` references for missing-target synthesis, coerces string/negative intervention and shock ticks, emits `ELASTICITY_DEVIATION_INPUT` / `ELASTICITY_NONPOSITIVE_BASELINE` warnings, and prevents negated report prose (`"no calibrated probability"`) from triggering false `VERBAL_PROBABILITY_CONTRADICTION` errors.
- **End-to-End Audit Verification.** Verified across all `18/18` release gates, `678` unit and integration tests, `30/30` calibrated `packs/economics` empirical hindcasts, and a live 24-month prospective policy simulation (`1000` Monte Carlo runs, `12` endogenous `tail_shock` clusters, sealed evidence + assumption human tracks) passing `17/17` final artifact gates at `score: 100.0` (`assurance_tier: "verified"`, `roleplay_tier: "A"`).

## Upgrade

Choose the [runtime ZIP](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/releases/download/v2.11.0/aleph-skill-runtime-v2.11.0.zip) for normal agent deployment or the [full ZIP](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/releases/download/v2.11.0/aleph-skill-v2.11.0.zip) for development, domain-pack hindcasts, and local release checks. Python 3.10+ and Node.js 18+ are supported.

Install into a fresh directory. Keep a backup of existing workspaces and preserve their declared `formula_version` when reproducing legacy runs (`2.0.0`, `2.1.0`, or `2.2.0`). Workspace schema `2.0.0` remains the write default, with schema `2.1.0` opt-in.

```sh
python3 scripts/preflight.py --json
python3 scripts/run_pipeline.py --self-test
```

## Verify the download

Put the two ZIPs, `distribution-manifest.json`, and `SHA256SUMS.txt` in one directory. Verify the cryptographic SHA-256 digests and GitHub SLSA build provenance before installing:

```sh
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt  # macOS alternative: shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt

gh attestation verify aleph-skill-v2.11.0.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.11.0

gh attestation verify aleph-skill-runtime-v2.11.0.zip \
  --repo d-init-d/aleph-skill \
  --signer-workflow d-init-d/aleph-skill/.github/workflows/release.yml \
  --source-ref refs/tags/v2.11.0
```

GitHub's attestation service verifies the immutable annotated source tag and workflow identity. The [release workflow](https://github.com/d-init-d/aleph-skill/actions/workflows/release.yml) records cross-platform test matrices (`Ubuntu`, `Windows`, `macOS`), reproducible archive builds, upstream component provenance verification, and SLSA build attestations.
